Here is the research and structured metadata for the Part 3 WhatsApp explainer videos batch (URLs 1–15):

---

### **1. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bf5K4fpWMA4** (Duplicate: posted 6/14 & 7/12)
* **Video Title:** Every Free App You Actually Need Explained in 20 Minutes
* **Channel Name:** Explainer Chris (@explainerguy01)
* **What the Video is About:** Explores essential, high-quality open-source and free software alternatives to expensive subscription applications across office productivity, video editing, graphics, audio, and game development.
* **Visual/Production Style:** Motion Graphics
* **Sub-Niche Category:** General Explainer

---

### **2. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FmrTrfcGzDk** (posted 6/14)
* **Video Title:** Why It Sucks to Be Born as a Giant Anaconda
* **Channel Name:** Dinzo
* **What the Video is About:** Narrates the brutal survival challenges, harsh environmental threats, and early life struggles of a newborn giant anaconda in the wild.
* **Visual/Production Style:** Stickman Animation
* **Sub-Niche Category:** Animals/Nature

---

### **3. https://youtu.be/tiQ2caFT7ao** (posted 6/20)
* **Video Title:** Every Type Of Shotgun Shell Explained
* **Channel Name:** Data illusion
* **What the Video is About:** Breaks down the mechanical design, internal components, gauges, and specific practical uses for various types of shotgun ammunition.
* **Visual/Production Style:** Motion Graphics
* **Sub-Niche Category:** General Explainer

---

### **4. https://youtu.be/mvLlCWAaiEI** (posted 6/20)
* **Video Title:** How Does It Feel to Die by Every Serial Killer?
* **Channel Name:** Mr Sticky
* **What the Video is About:** Examines the lethal techniques, psychological terror, and physical trauma inflicted by notorious historical serial killers.
* **Visual/Production Style:** Stickman Animation
* **Sub-Niche Category:** True Crime

---

### **5. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5i6rn3-qIe4** (posted 6/26)
* **Video Title:** How Humans Accidentally Created Guns
* **Channel Name:** Out of POV
* **What the Video is About:** Traces how ancient Chinese alchemists attempting to synthesize an elixir of immortality accidentally created gunpowder, sparking centuries of firearm evolution.
* **Visual/Production Style:** AI Image Sequence
* **Sub-Niche Category:** History

---

### **6. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2Bmg-uvbow** (posted 6/26)
